I am old now, 84 years, and my eyes and back are not what they were, but my family helps me work this maize plot. We are in Iringa where maize grows well with the rains, so I put one bag of fertilizer at planting like my neighbors do — without it the soil is tired. I keep my own maize seed from last harvest because the shop seed costs too much money, and we plant beans between the rows as we always have. I will hire a few young men to help with weeding when the rains come hard.
